review_locator: PMID:27125737, The FGF21 Receptor Signaling Complex: Klothoβ, FGFR1c, and Other Regulatory Interactions; PMID:30455427, The Klotho proteins in health and disease
primary_title: Structures of beta-Klotho reveal a zip code-like mechanism for endocrine FGF signalling; Dynamics and Distribution of Klotho-beta and FGFR1 in living cells reveal the FGF21-induced receptor complex
decision_basis: The reviews identify beta-Klotho with FGFR1c as the FGF21 receptor complex; the cited primary studies demonstrate beta-Klotho-dependent FGF21 receptor activation and ligand-induced transition to a 1:2 KLB-FGFR1c signaling complex.
limitations_preserved: Preserve beta-Klotho dependence, 1:2 KLB-FGFR1c signaling-complex model, heparan-sulfate/galectin and metabolic-cell context; no SCI transfer or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMID:30455427, The Klotho proteins in health and disease; PMID:27125737, The FGF21 Receptor Signaling Complex: Klothoβ, FGFR1c, and Other Regulatory Interactions
primary_title: Structures of ligand-occupied beta-Klotho complexes reveal a molecular mechanism underlying endocrine FGF specificity and activity
decision_basis: The reviews identify beta-Klotho-FGFR4 as the cognate FGF19 receptor complex; the cited primary study demonstrates FGF19 C-terminal binding to beta-Klotho and MAPK stimulation in FGFR4-plus-beta-Klotho cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve beta-Klotho and FGFR4 co-receptor context, FGF19 C-terminal binding, and cell-based MAPK scope; no claim of a complete solved membrane ternary complex or SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMID:37195242, Fibroblast growth factor 23, klotho and heparin; PMID:33338030, FGF23 signalling and physiology
primary_title: alpha-Klotho is a non-enzymatic molecular scaffold for FGF23 hormone signalling; Regulation of fibroblast growth factor-23 signaling by klotho
decision_basis: The reviews identify alpha-Klotho with FGFR1c as the cognate FGF23 receptor complex; the cited primary studies solve the FGF23-FGFR1c-alpha-Klotho ternary structure and demonstrate Klotho-enhanced FGF23 receptor signaling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve alpha-Klotho, FGFR1c, heparan-sulfate/dimerization requirements, and renal/endocrine comparator context; do not generalize to Klotho-independent FGFR branches or SCI.

review_locator: PMID:9872925, Vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and its receptors; PMID:11312109, Structure and dual function of vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-1 (Flt-1)
primary_title: Crystal structure at 1.7 A resolution of VEGF in complex with domain 2 of the Flt-1 receptor
decision_basis: The reviews identify VEGF-A as a high-affinity ligand for Flt-1/VEGFR1; the cited primary study solves the VEGF-Flt-1 domain-2 complex and maps the receptor-binding interface.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only promotion at the VEGF-A-FLT1 extracellular interface; preserve soluble/full-length Flt-1 distinction and do not infer productive endothelial relay or SCI function.

review_locator: PMID:14987558, Functions of the VEGF receptor-1 (FLT-1) in the vasculature; PMID:11312109, Structure and dual function of vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-1 (Flt-1)
primary_title: Flt-1 but not KDR/Flk-1 tyrosine kinase is a receptor for placenta growth factor, which is related to vascular endothelial growth factor
decision_basis: The reviews identify PlGF as an Flt-1/VEGFR1-selective ligand; the cited primary study shows PlGF competition for VEGF binding to Flt-1 and receptor-specific activity absent at KDR/Flk-1.
limitations_preserved: Preserve PlGF isoform and Flt-1-selective/anti-KDR boundary; primary evidence supports binding and receptor-specific activity but not a universal endothelial signaling mechanism or SCI transfer.

review_locator: PMID:24186067, Biology of the TAM receptors
primary_title: Localization and signaling of the receptor protein tyrosine kinase Tyro3 in cortical and hippocampal neurons; Requirement of Gamma-Carboxyglutamic Acid Modification and Phosphatidylserine Binding for the Activation of Tyro3, Axl, and Mertk Receptors by Growth Arrest-Specific 6
decision_basis: The review identifies Gas6 as a TAM ligand for Tyro3; the cited primary studies demonstrate Gas6-induced Tyro3 phosphorylation and MAPK/PI3K signaling in cortical and hippocampal neurons, with TAM-reporter validation of post-translational and phosphatidylserine requirements.
limitations_preserved: Activation/function-only because purified Gas6-Tyro3 binary binding is not isolated; preserve Gas6 gamma-carboxylation and phosphatidylserine context, receptor-family promiscuity, neuronal comparator, and no SCI/terminal-TF inference.
